newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber ends mixed on adjustment.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber ends mixed on adjustment.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices closed mixed on technical adjustment after the domestic market drifted without consumer demand, while the futures market in Tokyo ended lower, traders said.
At the close, July RSS1 buyer eased half cent to 277.50 cents ($1.10) a kg and July SMR 20 buyer was two cents higher at 257 cents.
A check with trading houses showed the SMR 20 offered at 252/253 cents, SMR 10 at 254/255, SMR 5 at 267, SMR CV at 324, SMR L at 303, and drum latex at 220.
Traders said there was no news of inquiries or sales for the day.
The INRO five-day average was 209.81 Malaysian/Singapore cents per kg on June 18 from 210.79 on June 17. The daily indicator was at 207.30 against 209.16 previously.
A Malaysia-based shipping agent quoted freight rates for rubber from Malaysia to Rotterdam at $800 per TEU and $1,700 per two-TEU containers.
